source.description:
**Height:** 150 cm (4'11")

A thief that lives in the slums. Felt stole [Emilia's](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) insignia, hoping for quick, easy cash. Though Felt can usually handle her own, she does consider [Rom](https://anilist.co/character/124117/Rom) to be like family.

~!After being chosen by the insignia, she is forced to participate in the Royal Selection and is currently a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica.!~

characters.name: Reinhard van Astrea
nicknames: ラインハルト・ヴァン・アストレア

source.name_native: ラインハルト・ヴァン・アストレア
source.description:
__Height__: 184 cm (6'0")

Reinhard van Astrea is the current Sword Saint and a member of the Royal Guard, currently acting as [Felt's](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt) knight. 

As the Sword Saint and the Knight of the Royal Guard, Reinhard embodies chivalry and elegance, treating everyone with exceptional respect. He is fair, brave, and always acts in the name of justice, whether on duty or simply strolling through the Royal Capital.

As a knight, Reinhard only uses his sword when necessary, since, in addition to being a rule, his iron-clad rule is to not inflict pain to others if not absolutely necessary, be it a normal thug or a member of the Witch Cult.

characters.name: Petelgeuse Romanee-Conti
nicknames: ペテルギウス・ロマネコンティ

source.name_native: ペテルギウス・ロマネコンティ
source.description:
Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing sloth.

~!He was later killed by [Natsuki Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) with the help of [Julius Juukulius](https://anilist.co/character/90183/Euclius-Julius).!~

~!A hundred years earlier, Petelgeuse was a moderate, upright and rational man. He was close friends with [Fortuna](https://anilist.co/character/183732/Fortuna) and [Emilia](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia), enough to be described as being like a family. However, when [Regulus](https://anilist.co/character/174098/Corneas-Regulus) and [Pandora](https://anilist.co/character/137522/Pandora) attacked their village, he accidentally killed Fortuna through Pandora's power, causing him to go mad.!~

characters.name: Anastasia Hoshin
nicknames: アナスタシア・ホーシン

source.name_native: アナスタシア・ホーシン
source.description:
Anastasia Hoshin is the head of the Hoshin Trading Company and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica. Her knight is [Julius Juukulius](https://anilist.co/character/90183/Euclius-Julius).

Despite her surname being "Hoshin", she's not directly related to Hoshin of the Wilderness. She chose the name because she was inspired by his legacy.

characters.name: Wilhelm van Astrea
nicknames: ヴィルヘルム・ヴァン・アストレア

source.name_native: ヴィルヘルム・ヴァン・アストレア
source.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")

Wilhelm van Astrea né Trias, is a member of the Crusch Camp and was [Theresia van Astrea](https://anilist.co/character/124116/van-Astrea-Theresia)'s husband.

Wilhelm is a refined man with a highly gentle and humble demeanor. However unearth that even temperament belied a fierce warrior who often is the first to help when something happens. However this wasn't always the case as in youth, Wilhelm was very opposite of who he was in his later years. Brash, afoot, short tempered, lonely and often cold with others. He was a troubled individual who devoted himself wholly to the sword and cared for little else. Even so, he knew how to analyze a situation, always finding a way out. Nonetheless, Theresia greatly influenced his personality, becoming increasingly sociable and protective, achieving more results during the Demi-human War. It was through her most of all that he would become the person he is today.

characters.name: Elsa Granhiert
nicknames: エルザ・グランヒルテ

source.name_native: エルザ・グランヒルテ
source.description:
An assassin-for-hire from the Northernmost nation, the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, known as "The Bowel Hunter". Elsa wishes to make a trade for an insignia, as her client's wishes.  

~!Elsa Granhiert was an assassin working together with [Meili](https://anilist.co/character/175577) for an individual they refer to as "Mother" until her death.!~

characters.name: Roswaal Mathers
nicknames: ロズワール・Ｌ・メイザース

source.name_native: ロズワール・Ｌ・メイザース
source.description:
~!__Mental age:__ 400+!~
The lord of the Roswaal Mansion and a descendant of the original Roswaal.

He comes across as an eccentric due to his flamboyant appearance and odd speaking style, the latter which he shares with his grandmother. However, he harbors a more calculating and reserved side with a sharp political mind and gaze that reads others quite well.

~!It is later revealed that he is in fact the original Roswaal, Roswaal A. Mathers, who has been possessing his descendants' bodies to meet his teacher Echidna again at any cost, even if that means sacrificing himself or those close to him.!~

characters.name: Julius Euclius
nicknames: ユリウス・ユークリウス

source.name_native: ユリウス・ユークリウス
source.description:
__Height:__ 179 cm (5'10")

Julius Euclius is [Anastasia Hoshin's](https://anilist.co/character/90177/Hoshin-Anastasi) knight and a member of the Royal Guard. Julius lived with his family at the Euclius House. After his father, Klein Euclius died, he started to live with his uncle Alviero and he started to take care of Julius and became his adoptive father.

As a member of Lugnica's nobility, Julius acts in a proper fashion, always having an air of nobility and conviction. He is also considerate and doesn't forget to show care toward others. He also shows a strict side, giving out accurate assessments of others whether they're good or bad, which is a result of his upbringing as an elite, and in actuality, he believes that he and others can do better than they currently are.

Julius doesn't like those who forget their place, leading him to have bad relations with [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) for a while. While both have apologized to each other after the battle with the Hakugei, Subaru told him he still hated him. Julius said he didn't intend to be friends. They both became very intimate very quickly during the planning and attacking the Witch Cult. In the end, Julius directly considered Subaru as his friend.

nicknames: フェリックス・アーガイル

source.name_native: フェリックス・アーガイル
source.description: Felix Argyle commonly known as Ferris, is [Crusch Karsten](https://anilist.co/character/90185)'s knight. He is a beast human (demi-human).

characters.name: Crusch Karsten
nicknames: クルシュ・カルステン
Goddess of War (戦争の女神; Sensou no Megami)

source.name_native: クルシュ・カルステン
name_alternative: Goddess of War (戦争の女神; Sensou no Megami)
source.description:
Crusch Karsten is the Matriarch of House Karsten and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugnica.

While normally calm and serious, Crusch is honest, sincere, right, being a type of person who is destined to stand above others, though she has talent and has worked hard to reach where she is now. She is already the head of her family, finishing her work better than her father. She prefers to act herself and has the pride of a warrior. Crusch is also gentle, often believing the false knowledge jokingly told to her by [Ferris](https://anilist.co/character/90184), and sometimes displays an airheaded side. Like her mother Helena Karsten, she is shown to be ruthless and reckless.

characters.name: Priscilla Barielle
nicknames: プリシラ・バーリエル

source.name_native: プリシラ・バーリエル
source.description: The matriarch of House Barielle and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica. Her knight is [Al](https://anilist.co/character/90178/Aldebaran).

__Height:__ 7 cm

Puck is an Artificial Spirit that [Emilia](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) was formerly contracted with. He is the current Great Spirit of Fire.

~!He is currently known as the Beast of The End.!~

~!Around 400 years ago, Puck was created by Echidna, though he had apparently left her by the time she moved into the Sanctuary. Seven years before the start of the election, Puck unfroze Emilia and began to act as her friend and mentor, and later on started to live at Roswaal's mansion where he was reunited with Beatrice.!~

Puck can be described as cute or adorable, thus his skin being pink around his cheeks. His fur is mostly grey with silver in certain spots (i.e. tip of the tail). His eyebrows are pretty small and rhombus-shaped. He also has a gold earring on his left ear. Sometimes, he carries a purple bag.

Puck is generally a nice spirit. He is very happy and stays at Emilia's side to protect her, affectionately calling her "Lia". He occasionally goofs around and gets along especially well with [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/90181/Beatrice). 

~!However, Puck's demeanor greatly changes in loops where Emilia dies, showing a complete disregard for anyone except her, and was even willing to destroy the world because of the condition in their contract.!~

characters.name: Otto Suwen
nicknames: オットー・スーウェン

source.name_native: オットー・スーウェン
source.description:
Otto Suwen is a merchant appearing in  Re:Zero. His remarkable misfortune always takes him to dangerous situations, from which he escapes thanks to his wit.
Otto has gray hair that is mentioned to be as long as a gal game protagonist. He is said to be somewhat handsome if he has a serious expression. However, he is usually either retorting, shouting, or panicking, ruining his looks. He has a medium build, but has trained himself since he used to work as a merchant.

One of the three thugs that attacked Subaru at the very start of Arc 1. 

~! He later joined the Felt Camp when [Felt](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt) employed him after Royal Selection began. After being employed by Felt, he started to get trained by Reinhard and has developed considerable power. !~

~! He was born as a noble from the Royal Capital of Lugunica, to [Rickert Hoffman](https://anilist.co/character/226757/Rickert-Hoffman) and an unnamed woman. However, after unknown events, he left his family and began living in the slums. He scorns his father and chose to cut ties with his family. !~
Rom, commonly known as Grandpa or Old Man Rom, is a member of the Felt Camp and the former owner of the Stolen Goods Warehouse.
Kadomon is a fruit seller in the royal capital.
Plum is the daughter of [Kadomon Risch](https://anilist.co/character/124118)

Petra is a bright and kind girl from Irlam Village. She likes [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) very much after he saved her from the Wolgarm incident.

~!She became a maid at the Roswaal Mansion after Subaru came back from the witchcult incident. !~

__Height:__ 135 cm (4'5")

Mimi is one of Anastasia Hoshin's followers and is one of three vice-captains of the mercenary group Fang of Steel.

~!Meili Portroute is a Demon Beast User.!~

[Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru)'s Earth Dragon that he officially received from [Crusch Karsten](https://anilist.co/character/90185/Karsten-Crusch) for his efforts in the Hakugei battle. Despite being of a species known for being feisty, Patrasche is extremely loyal to Subaru, as she is willing to put her life on the line for him.

characters.name: Bordeaux Zellgef
nicknames: ボルドー・ツェルゲフ

source.name_native: ボルドー・ツェルゲフ
source.description: Bordeaux Zellgef is a member of the Sage Council. During the Demi-Human war, he acted as the captain of the Zellgef Squadron. Four decades ago during the Demi-Human War, Bordeaux was a tall, muscular and somewhat frightening man, usually donned in heavy iron armour and wielding a massive battle axe. He had short and spiky light blue hair, and equally blue and thick eyebrows. His eyes radiated a strong fighting spirit.

characters.name: Miklotov McMahon
nicknames: マイクロトフ・マクマホン

source.name_native: マイクロトフ・マクマホン
source.description: The representative of the Council of Wise Men who are currently ruling over the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica. Many have considered Miklotov to be the true brains of the Kingdom who, in the event that the royal family were to disappear, would be a suitable replacement ruler.

Satella is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Envy. ~! Contrary to popular belief, Satella and the Witch of Envy are separate personalities. Both of them love Subaru, though the Witch of Envy is aggressive about it.!~

characters.name: Frederica Baumann
nicknames: フレデリカ・バウマン

source.name_native: フレデリカ・バウマン
source.description:
Frederica Baumann is a maid working for [Roswaal L. Mathers](https://anilist.co/character/90182/Mathers-Roswaal) and a member of the Emilia Camp. She quit her job as a maid a few months before [Subaru's](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) appearance, but returned after [Ram](https://anilist.co/character/88576/Ram) couldn't manage the mansion ~!after [Rem](https://anilist.co/character/88575/Rem) had her name and memories eaten. !~

~!She is the half-sister of [Garfiel Tinsel](https://anilist.co/character/133847/Tinsel-Garfiel).!~
Schult is a member of the Priscilla Camp. Though not much is known about him, he's extremely loyal to his mistress and is one of her closest attendants.
Chamov is a puppy demihuman, with white hair, blue eyes, and an amiable puppy face. He typically likes to wear a hat.
